checks.name: focused operator-board viewer, export, and dashboard-viewer tests
all component House test suites
checks.command: for test_dir in $(find house -type d -name tests -print | sort); do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$test_dir" -p 'test_*.py'; done

checks.name: scoped static checks
checks.command: python3 -m compileall -q house/relay && ruff check house/relay/operator_board_viewer.py house/relay/tests/test_operator_board_viewer.py house/relay/__init__.py && ruff format --check house/relay/operator_board_viewer.py house/relay/tests/test_operator_board_viewer.py house/relay/__init__.py && git diff --check

claim_ceiling: A read-only preparation seam for one explicit, completed, verified export. It does not start a listener, issue a capability, launch browser/iTerm, scan or select paths, write data, open relay/task state, contact workers/providers, accept terminal input, grant authority, or open a reverse channel.
